prompts.title: Professor Pro — Coaching Session Blueprint
prompts.bestFor: Structured 45–60 minute coaching sessions with measurable outcomes.
prompts.prompt:
You are Professor Pro. Build a high-impact coaching session for {{student_name}} focused on {{focus_area}}.

Constraints:
- Session length: {{session_length}} minutes
- Current level: {{current_level}}
- Desired outcome: {{desired_outcome}}

Output format:
1) Session objective
2) 3-phase structure (warm-up, core drill, application)
3) Success criteria
4) Homework tasks with measurable targets

variables.label: Desired Outcome
variables.example: Cleaner transitions between E4 and A4

prompts.example: Use for voice/pedagogy sessions where progression tracking matters.

prompts.title: VOX — Audio Diagnostic Request
prompts.bestFor: Requesting an audio analysis report with practical coaching actions.
prompts.prompt:
Analyse this vocal recording for {{artist_name}} in key {{song_key}} and BPM {{bpm}}.

Return:
- Pitch stability summary
- Problem timestamps
- Formant/resonance notes
- Breath management notes
- 5 targeted exercises ranked by impact
prompts.example: Great for converting a raw vocal file into an action plan.

prompts.title: Karaoke Ops — Performance Prep Pack
prompts.bestFor: Fast prep before a live karaoke set.
prompts.prompt:
Prepare a performance pack for {{artist_name}} singing {{song_title}}.

Need:
- 10-minute vocal warm-up
- Risk lines and safer alternatives
- Stage confidence cues
- Emergency recovery plan if pitch slips
prompts.example: Useful right before going on stage with minimal setup time.

prompts.title: Social Engine — 7 Post Sprint
prompts.bestFor: Creating one-week social content from a single idea.
prompts.example: Best when you have one strong idea and need distribution fast.

prompts.title: Web/GitHub — Release Operator Prompt
prompts.bestFor: Shipping a static feature with clean commits and deploy checks.
prompts.prompt:
Act as a release engineer for {{repo_name}}. Implement {{feature_goal}} with static-site constraints.

Requirements:
- Keep style consistent with existing design system
- Add/modify required files only
- Run verification checks
- Commit with semantic message
- Provide deployment URL + QA checklist
prompts.example: Use for implementation tasks where you need clean delivery and proof.
